s0666.literal: When the Great Way was already hidden, All-under-Heaven became a family; the earlier kings established norms for husband and wife, father and son, ruler and minister, superior and inferior, close and distant.
s0666.idiomatic: When the Great Way was already hidden, All-under-Heaven became a family; the earlier kings established norms for husband and wife, father and son, ruler and minister, superior and inferior, close and distant.

s0667.literal: Down to the Three Dynasties, additions and subtractions differed.
s0667.idiomatic: Down to the Three Dynasties, additions and subtractions differed.

s0668.literal: When Zhou declined, feudal lords overstepped and transgressed; hating that rites harmed themselves, many were burned and cut away.
s0668.idiomatic: When Zhou declined, feudal lords overstepped and transgressed; hating that rites harmed themselves, many were burned and cut away.

s0669.literal: Already in Confucius's time they could not be complete; by Qin they suddenly perished.
s0669.idiomatic: Already in Confucius's time they could not be complete; by Qin they suddenly perished.

s0670.literal: At the beginning of Han, Gao Tang transmitted seventeen chapters; there was also an old classic from Yanzhong; King Xian of Hejian loved antiquity and learning, gathered what remained from the ashes, obtained and presented them—fifty-six chapters in all, including matters of ritual decorum.
s0670.idiomatic: At the beginning of Han, Gao Tang transmitted seventeen chapters; there was also an old classic from Yanzhong; King Xian of Hejian loved antiquity and learning, gathered what remained from the ashes, obtained and presented them—fifty-six chapters in all, including matters of ritual decorum.

s0671.literal: 而又得司馬穰苴兵法一百五十五篇，及明堂陰陽之記，並無敢傳之者。.
s0671.idiomatic: 而又得司馬穰苴兵法一百五十五篇，及明堂陰陽之記，並無敢傳之者。.

s0672.literal: Only the seventeen chapters of the old classic did not differ from what Gao Tang transmitted, though the characters differed in many places.
s0672.idiomatic: Only the seventeen chapters of the old classic did not differ from what Gao Tang transmitted, though the characters differed in many places.

s0673.literal: 自高堂生至宣帝時後蒼，最明其業，乃為曲台記。.
s0673.idiomatic: 自高堂生至宣帝時後蒼，最明其業，乃為曲台記。.

s0674.literal: Cang taught Dai De of Liang and De's cousin's son Sheng and Qing Pu of Pei—hence there were the Great Dai, Lesser Dai, and Qing schools, all three established.
s0674.idiomatic: Cang taught Dai De of Liang and De's cousin's son Sheng and Qing Pu of Pei—hence there were the Great Dai, Lesser Dai, and Qing schools, all three established.

s0675.literal: In Later Han only Cao Yuan transmitted the Qing school and taught his son Bao.
s0675.idiomatic: In Later Han only Cao Yuan transmitted the Qing school and taught his son Bao.

s0676.literal: Yet though the three schools survived they were all weak; transmission never ceased.
s0676.idiomatic: Yet though the three schools survived they were all weak; transmission never ceased.

s0677.literal: At the end of Han, Zheng Xuan transmitted the Lesser Dai school, then collated it against the old classic, took what was sound in meaning, and annotated it—this was the Zheng school.
s0677.idiomatic: At the end of Han, Zheng Xuan transmitted the Lesser Dai school, then collated it against the old classic, took what was sound in meaning, and annotated it—this was the Zheng school.

s0678.literal: 其喪服一篇，子夏先傳之，諸儒多為注解，今又別行。.
s0678.idiomatic: 其喪服一篇，子夏先傳之，諸儒多為注解，今又別行。.

s0680.literal: 周官蓋周公所制官政之法，上于河間獻王，獨闕冬官一篇。.
s0680.idiomatic: 周官蓋周公所制官政之法，上于河間獻王，獨闕冬官一篇。.

s0681.literal: 獻王購以千金不得，遂取考工記以補其處，合成六篇奏之。.
s0681.idiomatic: 獻王購以千金不得，遂取考工記以補其處，合成六篇奏之。.

s0682.literal: By Wang Mang's time, Liu Xin first established erudites, and it circulated in the world.
s0682.idiomatic: By Wang Mang's time, Liu Xin first established erudites, and it circulated in the world.

s0683.literal: Goushi of Henan and Du Zichun received instruction from Xin and thus taught others.
s0683.idiomatic: Goushi of Henan and Du Zichun received instruction from Xin and thus taught others.

s0684.literal: 是後馬融作周官傳，以授鄭玄，玄作周官注。.
s0684.idiomatic: 是後馬融作周官傳，以授鄭玄，玄作周官注。.

s0685.literal: At the beginning of Han, King Xian of Hejian also obtained one hundred thirty-one chapters recorded by Confucius's disciples and later scholars and presented them; at the time there was also no one who transmitted them.
s0685.idiomatic: At the beginning of Han, King Xian of Hejian also obtained one hundred thirty-one chapters recorded by Confucius's disciples and later scholars and presented them; at the time there was also no one who transmitted them.

s0686.literal: When Liu Xiang collated the classics and records, he found one hundred thirty chapters; Xiang arranged and ordered them.
s0686.idiomatic: When Liu Xiang collated the classics and records, he found one hundred thirty chapters; Xiang arranged and ordered them.

s0687.literal: 而又得明堂陰陽記三十三篇、孔子三朝記七篇、王史氏記二十一篇、Music記二十三篇，凡五種，合二百十四篇。.
s0687.idiomatic: 而又得明堂陰陽記三十三篇、孔子三朝記七篇、王史氏記二十一篇、Music記二十三篇，凡五種，合二百十四篇。.

s0688.literal: 戴德刪其煩重，合而記之，為八十五篇，謂之大戴記。.
s0688.idiomatic: 戴德刪其煩重，合而記之，為八十五篇，謂之大戴記。.

s0689.literal: 而戴聖又刪大戴之Documents，為四十六篇，謂之小戴記。.
s0689.idiomatic: 而戴聖又刪大戴之Documents，為四十六篇，謂之小戴記。.

s0690.literal: At the end of Han, Ma Rong transmitted the Lesser Dai school.
s0690.idiomatic: At the end of Han, Ma Rong transmitted the Lesser Dai school.

s0691.literal: 融又定月令一篇、明堂位一篇、Music記一篇，合四十九篇；.
s0691.idiomatic: 融又定月令一篇、明堂位一篇、Music記一篇，合四十九篇；.

s0692.literal: Zheng Xuan received instruction from Rong and also annotated it.
s0692.idiomatic: Zheng Xuan received instruction from Rong and also annotated it.

s0693.literal: 今周官六篇、古經十七篇、小戴記四十九篇，凡三種。.
s0693.idiomatic: 今周官六篇、古經十七篇、小戴記四十九篇，凡三種。.

s0694.literal: 唯鄭注立于國學，其餘並多散亡，又無師說。.
s0694.idiomatic: 唯鄭注立于國學，其餘並多散亡，又無師說。.
